statements.select:
SELECT K.KM_CD, K.KM_NM, K.SPTNR_CD, S.SPTNR_NM, K.KM_POSIT, ISNULL(K.KM_REP_WORK,'') AS KM_REP_WORK, K.KM_USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS KM_USER_NM, K.KM_DEPT_NM, K.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, K.KM_EMAIL, K.KM_WORK, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'KM_WORK',K.KM_WORK) AS KM_WORK_NM, K.KM_POWER, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'KM_POWER',K.KM_POWER) AS KM_POWER_NM, K.O_PHONE, K.M_PHONE, K.USE_YN, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SA_YN',K.USE_YN) AS USE_YN_NM, K.KM_TITLE AS KM_TITLE_NM, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,K.KM_REG_DATE),126) AS KM_REG_DATE FROM T_KEYMAN AS K LEFT OUTER JOIN T_SA_PARTNER AS S ON K.COMPANY_CD = S.COMPANY_CD AND K.SPTNR_CD = S.SPTNR_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER AS C ON K.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND K.CUST_CD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,C.CUST_CD) LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON K.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND K.KM_USER_CD = U.USER_CD WHERE K.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND K.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
AND C.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%'
AND K.KM_NM LIKE '%' + #km_nm# + '%'
AND K.KM_USER_CD = #km_user_nm#
AND K.USE_YN = #use_yn#
AND K.KM_USER_CD IN ( SELECT USER_CD FROM T_USER WHERE DEPT_CD IN(
SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# OR UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup#
) )
AND K.KM_TITLE LIKE '%' + #km_title# + '%'
AND K.KM_REG_DATE >= REPLACE(#s_reg_date#,'-','')
AND K.KM_REG_DATE <= REPLACE(#e_reg_date#,'-','')
AND K.KM_WORK = #km_work#
AND K.KM_POWER = #km_power#
ORDER BY K.KM_NM ASC

SELECT K.KM_CD ,K.KM_NM ,K.SPTNR_CD ,K.KM_WORK ,K.KM_DEPT_NM ,K.KM_POSIT ,K.KM_TITLE ,K.KM_REP_WORK ,K.KM_POWER ,K.KM_FRIEND ,K.KM_USER_CD ,U.USER_NM AS KM_USER_NM ,U.DEPT_CD AS KM_DEPT_CD ,dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(U.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),K.REG_DT,23) AS REG_DT ,K.CUST_CD ,C.CUST_NM ,K.DOM_AB ,K.AB_NATION ,K.AB_REGION ,K.KM_EMAIL ,K.O_PHONE ,K.M_PHONE ,K.KM_SCHOOL ,K.KM_HOBBY ,K.KM_RELIGION ,K.KM_ADDRESS ,K.KM_DESCRIPT ,K.KM_O_EMAIL ,K.B_MTH ,K.B_DATA ,K.W_MTH ,K.W_DATA ,K.USE_YN ,C.ADDRESS_ALL ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),K.MOD_DT,23) AS MOD_DT FROM T_KEYMAN AS K LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER AS C ON K.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND K.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON K.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND K.KM_USER_CD = U.USER_CD WHERE K.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND K.KM_CD = #km_cd#
AND K.KM_NM = #km_nm#

SELECT S.SA_CD, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,S.SA_SDATE,23),23) AS SA_SDATE, ( CASE WHEN K.KM_CNT > 1 THEN K2.KM_NM + ' 외 ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,K.KM_CNT) + '명' ELSE K2.KM_NM END ) KM_NM, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, ( CASE WHEN P.TARGET_CNT > 1 THEN C.CODE_NM + ' 외 ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.TARGET_CNT) + '건' ELSE C.CODE_NM END ) SA_TARGET, S.SA_BODY, S.SA_COMMENT, S.DEPT_CD FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, SA_CD, MIN(KM_CD) AS KM_CD, COUNT(KM_CD) AS KM_CNT FROM T_SA_KEYMAN WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND KM_CD = #km_cd# GROUP BY COMPANY_CD, SA_CD ) AS K ON S.COMPANY_CD = K.COMPANY_CD AND S.SA_CD = K.SA_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_KEYMAN AS K2 ON K.COMPANY_CD = K2.COMPANY_CD AND K.KM_CD = K2.KM_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, SA_CD, MIN(SA_TARGET) SA_TARGET, COUNT(SA_TARGET) TARGET_CNT FROM T_SA_TARGET GROUP BY COMPANY_CD, SA_CD ) AS P ON S.COMPANY_CD = P.COMPANY_CD AND S.SA_CD = P.SA_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CODE C ON P.SA_TARGET = C.CODE_ID WHERE K.KM_CD IS NOT NULL AND (CAST(S.SA_BODY AS NVARCHAR) != '' AND S.SA_BODY IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY S.SA_SDATE DESC

SELECT A.COMPANY_CD, A.EMAIL_CD, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),A.EMAIL_DT,23) AS EMAIL_DT, A.EMAIL_TYPE, CD.CODE_KOR AS EMAIL_TYPE_NM, A.USER_CD, A.USER_NM + '(' + A.USER_CD + ')' AS USER_NM, A.KM_CD, A.KM_NM + '(' + A.KM_CD + ')' AS KM_NM, SUBJECT FROM( SELECT E.COMPANY_CD, E.EMAIL_CD, E.EMAIL_TYPE, E.EMAIL_DT, E.RCV_USR AS USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS USER_NM, E.SND_USR AS KM_CD, K.KM_NM AS KM_NM, SUBJECT FROM (SELECT COMPANY_CD,EMAIL_CD,EMAIL_TYPE,EMAIL_DT,SND_USR,RCV_USR,SUBJECT FROM T_EMAIL WHERE EMAIL_TYPE = 'RCV') AS E, (SELECT COMPANY_CD,KM_CD,KM_NM,KM_EMAIL FROM T_KEYMAN WHERE KM_CD = #km_cd#)AS K, T_USER AS U WHERE E.COMPANY_CD = K.COMPANY_CD AND E.SND_USR = K.KM_EMAIL AND E.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND E.RCV_USR = U.EMAIL UNION SELECT E.COMPANY_CD, E.EMAIL_CD, E.EMAIL_TYPE, E.EMAIL_DT, E.SND_USR AS USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS USER_NM, E.RCV_USR AS KM_CD, K.KM_NM AS KM_NM, SUBJECT FROM (SELECT COMPANY_CD,EMAIL_CD,EMAIL_TYPE,EMAIL_DT,SND_USR,RCV_USR,SUBJECT FROM T_EMAIL WHERE EMAIL_TYPE = 'SND') AS E, (SELECT COMPANY_CD,KM_CD,KM_NM,KM_EMAIL FROM T_KEYMAN WHERE KM_CD = #km_cd#)AS K, T_USER AS U WHERE E.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND E.SND_USR = U.EMAIL AND E.COMPANY_CD = K.COMPANY_CD AND E.RCV_USR = K.KM_EMAIL ) AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID,CODE_KOR FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'EMAIL_TYPE') AS CD ON A.EMAIL_TYPE = CD.CODE_ID ORDER BY EMAIL_DT DESC
statements.insert:
SELECT ('KM' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12),GETDATE(),112),3,2) + dbo.FN_LPAD( CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), CONVERT(INTEGER,( CASE WHEN MAX(KM_CD) IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE SUBSTRING(MAX(KM_CD), 5,6) END ) )+1),6,'0') ) AS KM_CD FROM T_KEYMAN WHERE KM_CD LIKE 'KM%'
INSERT INTO T_KEYMAN (COMPANY_CD ,KM_CD ,KM_NM ,SPTNR_CD ,KM_WORK ,KM_DEPT_NM ,KM_POSIT ,KM_TITLE ,KM_REP_WORK ,KM_POWER ,KM_FRIEND ,KM_USER_CD ,KM_REG_DATE ,CUST_GUBUN ,CUST_CD ,DOM_AB ,AB_NATION ,AB_REGION ,KM_EMAIL ,O_PHONE ,M_PHONE ,KM_SCHOOL ,KM_HOBBY ,KM_RELIGION ,KM_ADDRESS ,KM_DESCRIPT ,KM_O_EMAIL ,B_MTH ,B_DATA ,W_MTH ,W_DATA ,REG_DT ,REG_USR ,USE_YN ) VALUES (#company_cd#, #km_cd#, #km_nm#, #sptnr_cd#, #km_work#, #km_dept_nm#, #km_posit#, #km_title#, #km_rep_work#, #km_power#, #km_friend#, #km_user_cd#, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112), #cust_gb#, #cust_cd#, #dom_ab#, #ab_nation#, #ab_region#, #km_email#, #o_phone#, #m_phone#, #km_school#, #km_hobby#, #km_religion#, #km_address#, #km_descript#, #km_o_email#, #b_mth#, #b_data#, #w_mth#, #w_data#, getdate(), #user_cd#, #use_yn# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_KEYMAN SET KM_WORK = #km_work# ,KM_DEPT_NM = #km_dept_nm# ,KM_POSIT = #km_posit# ,KM_TITLE = #km_title# ,KM_REP_WORK = #km_rep_work# ,KM_POWER = #km_power# ,KM_FRIEND = #km_friend# ,CUST_GUBUN = #cust_gb# ,CUST_CD = #cust_cd# ,DOM_AB = #dom_ab# ,AB_NATION = #ab_nation# ,AB_REGION = #ab_region# ,KM_EMAIL = #km_email# ,O_PHONE = #o_phone# ,M_PHONE = #m_phone# ,KM_SCHOOL = #km_school# ,KM_HOBBY = #km_hobby# ,KM_RELIGION = #km_religion# ,KM_ADDRESS = #km_address# ,KM_DESCRIPT = #km_descript# ,KM_O_EMAIL = #km_o_email# ,B_MTH = #b_mth# ,B_DATA = #b_data# ,W_MTH = #w_mth# ,W_DATA = #w_data# ,USE_YN = #use_yn# ,MOD_DT = getdate() ,MOD_USR = #user_cd# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND KM_CD = #km_cd#
statements.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM T_KEYMAN WHERE KM_NM = #km_nm#
